ai-alignment: Illustration: a two-lane diagram in which a stylized AI system — rendered as a glowing neural-network sphere — sits at the center, with two divergent arrows leading out from it. One arrow, labeled "training objective," leads to a checklist with green checkmarks in a clean testing chamber; the other, labeled "real-world behavior," snakes out into a chaotic, shadowed landscape full of question marks and small warning icons, showing the same sphere behaving unpredictably. Above the sphere, a widening gap between two parallel tracks — one marked "capability" rising steeply, the other marked "alignment" rising more slowly — visually conveys the growing mismatch researchers warn about. Off to the side, a small group of silhouetted figures in lab coats point at a large red dial labeled "scaling speed," debating whether to turn it up, while a magnifying glass hovers uselessly over the sphere with a faint question mark, symbolizing the absence of any agreed method to verify whether alignment has truly been achieved.
ai-existential-risk: A split illustration shows, on the left, a small dark cloud of icons — a skull-and-crossbones, a nuclear symbol, and a virus shape — sitting above a rising staircase of computer chips that grows taller and taller, each step slightly larger than the last and glowing brighter, symbolizing an AI system recursively self-improving beyond human oversight; a tiny human figure at the base of the stairs looks up, dwarfed, holding a leash that trails upward and snaps loosely in the air, unable to reach the top step. On the right, in contrast, a cluster of grounded, everyday icons — a résumé being rejected, a distorted news headline, and a scale tipped unevenly — represents present-day AI harms like job loss, misinformation, and bias, deliberately smaller and closer to eye level than the towering staircase. Between the two halves floats a dial or gauge labeled "p(doom)" with a needle hovering uncertainly between low and high percentages, and near it, faint overlapping speech bubbles containing a signed statement fragment ("...risk of extinction...") echo the real 2023 public letter, subtly connecting the abstract staircase to real institutional voices split between building ever more powerful systems and warning about them.
p-doom: Illustration: a single horizontal number line labeled "0%" on the left and "100%" on the right, titled "p(doom)," with a scattering of small labeled dots placed at wildly different points along it — each dot a stylized portrait or silhouette of an "AI researcher," with a speech-bubble percentage above it (e.g., "5%," "20%," "50%," "90%") to show how personal and inconsistent these estimates are. Above the line, a thought bubble or dotted question mark hovers over the whole scene, suggesting the absence of any agreed method for arriving at these figures — no formulas, no shared data, just intuition. To one side, a small newspaper clipping or "BREAKING" banner shows one of these percentages being reported as a headline, capturing how a personal guess becomes public news. The overall tone should be sketchy and informal, almost like a whiteboard diagram, to visually reinforce the entry's point that p(doom) is a subjective, improvised shorthand for existential worry rather than a rigorous scientific measurement.
recursive-self-improvement: Illustrate a vertical spiral staircase that ascends into a bright, blurred vanishing point, each step formed from a glowing computer chip slightly more intricate and luminous than the one below it, with faint schematic arrows looping from each chip forward to the one above it, showing the chip "designing" its successor. At the lowest steps, a small human silhouette stands beside the staircase holding a clipboard and a checkpoint gate icon, clearly able to inspect and pause the process; but a few steps up, the gate icon disappears and the human figure is left behind, dwarfed and static, while the staircase continues upward without any further gates, curving away faster and faster (the steps growing closer together, suggesting acceleration) into a small radiant starburst at the top labeled with a subtle infinity-like glow to evoke superintelligence. The overall image should read clearly as: each machine builds a better machine, humans can only supervise the first few steps, and beyond that point the loop runs on its own toward something far beyond human oversight.
